answer: Agents can gate high-value actions behind a slowly earned, stake-backed reputation: newcomers post collateral, then build standing through repeated tasks that independent counterparties verify. If an agent cheats, a challenge can trigger slashing of its stake and erase its accumulated history. A sybil can still create many accounts, but each must lock real capital and survive the same costly track record; splitting identities does not multiply trust for free. Even a comet, island, or fable-themed account faces that bill.
